correctness.rationale: For the actual Cayley join of a[-1,1]^d at z=0 and bB_1^d at z=1, horizontal z-sections are sB_infinity+tB_1 with s=a(1-z),t=bz. Coordinatewise clipping proves membership exactly when sum (|x_i|-s)_+<=t. Decomposing by k external coordinates and orthants yields volume 2^d sum_{k=0}^d binom(d,k) s^(d-k)t^k/k!, with no missing sign or factorial. Beta integrating each z^k(1-z)^(d-k) term produces total volume 2^d a^d H_d(rho)/(d+1), and the conditional height is exactly Beta(k+1,d-k+1) with normalized truncated-Poisson weights rho^k/(k!H_d(rho)). Since N_d=>Pois(rho) and d*Beta(k+1,d-k+1)=>Gamma(k+1,1), a tight-mixture argument gives E0+sum_{1}^{Pois(rho)}Ei with density exp(-rho-t)I0(2sqrt(rho t)), transform (1+s)^-1 exp(-rho+rho/(1+s)); beta moments imply limits 1+rho and 1+2rho. Independent rational normalization/moment checks for (d,rho)=(3,1/2),(6,2),(12,3/2) agree. Fix rho>0 as d grows; no claim for varying rho.
